title: Make the operation-warning tests check the warning's behaviour, not its exact English sentence
outcome: Make the operation-warning tests check the warning's behaviour, not its exact English sentence
acceptance: The launcher warning tests (scripts/test-launcher-tests/registration.mjs and the other launcher suites) and the Rust operation_time warning tests assert warning count, timing, operation name, attempt and the operation's unchanged outcome, and match the warning sentence's wording only where it is part of a documented output contract, so rewording 'is still running after 10 seconds' leaves them passing
